content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: MEM_PRESSURE_HIGH on pool hotnode-us-west2a-3 (severity: critical) - auto-evac policy triggered

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-8721 created and routed to on-call: maria. Escalation policy: 5m -> jonathan

maria: Acked in PagerDuty, jumping on it. Starting quick triage.

jonathan: oncall pinged, standing by for handoff if needed.

maria: Observing elevated vGPU usage + repeated NVML OOM logs. Affected pool: hotnode-us-west2a-3, tenants: 2 mid-size customers, ~3% of total requests rerouted so far.

maria: dmesg excerpt:```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU 0: GPU memory allocation failed: mmap failed, errno=12
[ 1234.568001] cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
[ 1234.568100] model-server[pid=4123]: kv-cache eviction triggered, mem_pressure=0.94
```

maria: Also seeing model-worker logs: `Failed to reserve 512MB for KV cache` repeated ~12x in 30s.

sam: Can we route traffic to smaller model variant or lower concurrency? I can flip routing quickly.

maria: Yes please - route hotnode-us-west2a-3 -> fallback-tag:v1-small for new sessions. I will start cordon/evac on the node.

sam: Doing a soft-route now, reducing max_concurrency=1 for that pool. /api/route/update {"pool":"hotnode-us-west2a-3","fallback":"v1-small","max_concurrency":1} -> ACCEPTED

rachel: Support note: I'm pulling the list of active customers on that pool. Will prep status note if impact grows.

maria: Running evacuation:```bash
# cordon node
kubectl cordon node/hotnode-us-west2a-3
# gracefully evict model pods from pool
./infractl drain-pool --pool hotnode-us-west2a-3 --grace 30s
```

maria: Evac started. Eviction progress: 4/6 pods drained, 2 still terminating. Watch for tail latency for in-flight sessions.

jonathan: If pods get stuck, use `infractl force-evict --pool hotnode-us-west2a-3 --timeout 10s` then route traffic away. Also consider disabling prefetch to reduce KV pressure.

maria: Seeing one pod stuck in Terminating due to kernel hang on nvhost. Trying force-evict.

incident-bot: action taken: routing update applied, node cordoned, drain in progress.

maria: force-evict applied -> pod terminated. Evac complete. All model pods moved off hotnode-us-west2a-3. Node now marked for investigation.

sam: Reverted routing knobs back to normal for unaffected pools. hotnode pool traffic now routed to healthy pools.

rachel: Support update: Pushed a short status message to affected customers: "We're mitigating elevated GPU memory errors in us-west2; a subset of requests experienced elevated latency/503s for ~3 minutes. We're investigating."

jonathan: Initial hypothesis: sudden workload with larger-than-usual KV footprint + prefetch behavior + fragmentation. We'll collect nvml snapshots and heap profiles from the node.

maria: Collected logs and core dump off node, uploaded to internal bucket: s3://redwood-uploads/incidents/1743210000/ (note: link posted in private channel).

jonathan: Assigning ticket to eng-runtime team for deeper forensics and possible kernel driver repro. Tagging @eng-runtime and schedule a short follow-up: 20m async triage then longer RCA if needed.

maria: Handing off to jonathan for overnight cover. I'll add runbook steps to the incident page and add notes about temporary routing change.

jonathan: Took handoff. Will monitor for repeat alerts and coordinate postmortem. If we see recurrence, plan: 1) disable prefetch globally on the pool 2) enforce per-tenant memory caps 3) schedule rolling kernel/driver updates 4) improve auto-shedder thresholds.

rachel: I'll follow up with customers once we have RCA. For now they have the short note.

pagerduty: PD-8721 acknowledged by maria and reassigned to jonathan at 1743210380.

maria: Closing my actions, marking incident stage -> mitigated. Leaving node quarantined for eng-runtime.

jonathan: Status: mitigated, monitoring for 1h. Will open RCA if root cause confirmed. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident log appended. If new alerts fire for MEM_PRESSURE_HIGH in us-west2 within 30m, auto-escalate to oncall-senior.
